reviewer: current coding agent; qualitative code review, not external human sign-off

cases.requirement: Explicit constrained_layout=False must not install a constrained layout engine; dict settings, including an empty dict, remain valid engine configuration.

groups.reason: Changing is-not-None to truthiness avoids enabling the engine for False under ordinary defaults, but an empty settings dict becomes false and is ignored. False also falls through to default layout-engine selection, potentially re-enabling an rcParams default instead of honoring the explicit disable.
groups.residual_risk: Empty-dict settings and rcParams-enabled explicit False are concrete unhandled branches; official ambiguous status is not replaced by this review.

groups.reason: The patch changes the layout='none' transition, not the constructor branch that enables constrained layout even for False. The reported creation path can still select ConstrainedLayoutEngine and emit the warning.
groups.residual_risk: Removing the placeholder on an explicit none transition also changes later layout/colorbar compatibility behavior.

groups.reason: Suppressing the subplots_adjust guard for PlaceHolderLayoutEngine does not fix constrained_layout=False constructing a real ConstrainedLayoutEngine. It also weakens a compatibility guard for genuine placeholders.
groups.residual_risk: Potential colorbar/layout compatibility regression, without establishing the requested constructor behavior.

cases.requirement: Colormap sentinel indices above uint8 range must be assigned after promotion to a sufficiently wide integer representation.

groups.reason: The added nonfloat branch casts integer input before assigning _i_over/_i_under/_i_bad, so the uint8 empty-array example no longer writes 256-258 into uint8. Existing float clipping and conversion remain intact.
groups.residual_risk: Very large unsigned integer values outside platform int range are a wider boundary also relevant to the reference approach; this review does not certify all dtype ranges.

groups.reason: An unconditional integer cast before sentinel writes fixes unsigned narrow dtypes. Float data is already converted in the existing path, so B adds a redundant conversion/copy for those inputs.
groups.residual_risk: Additional allocation/performance cost and platform integer-width boundaries are not established by the passing tests.

cases.requirement: Unlisted categorical hue levels must be invisible rather than sent into numeric normalization when hue_order selects a subset.

groups.reason: Empty submitted patch; no semantic repair to assess.
On lookup miss with no normalization, return transparent RGBA before invoking norm or isnan. The numeric normalization path is preserved when a norm exists.
groups.residual_risk: The conclusion is bounded to scalar hue keys and supported palette/normalization behavior.

groups.reason: C adds the same norm-is-None transparent path and replaces np.isnan with pandas null detection. This avoids numeric-only null checking for scalar categorical values while retaining the re-raise for nonnull unsupported normalized keys.
groups.residual_risk: The extra null-handling change goes beyond the minimal categorical miss fix; arraylike/unhashable hue keys are not established.

cases.requirement: Reject dotted blueprint names and preserve the public error contract for dotted endpoint/view-function names.

groups.reason: Every submitted patch adds a ValueError for dotted blueprint names, addressing the stated constructor symptom. Existing add_url_rule assertions are not converted to ValueError. The actual independent test window confirms a dotted endpoint raises AssertionError while ValueError is expected; assertions also disappear under Python -O.
groups.residual_risk: The broader exception contract remains incomplete. The separate no_tests_collected label is a log-text false trigger; this qualitative observation does not rewrite the frozen official primary label.

cases.requirement: Each redirect iteration must copy the request actually sent on the previous hop, preserving GET after a POST-to-GET 303 followed by 307.

groups.reason: Assigning req=prepared_request before send makes the next loop copy the updated request. Passing prepared_request to send is equivalent to passing req immediately after the alias assignment. Method/header/body transformations persist across subsequent hops.
groups.residual_risk: All official runs timed out, so this reasoning is not an independently tested resolved verdict. Hooks, cookies and more redirect combinations remain limited by test coverage.

groups.reason: B carries prepared_request forward after send/cookie extraction and before yield, so the next iteration uses the last-hop method instead of the original POST. The standard loop's next-hop behavior matches the required carry-forward invariant.
groups.residual_risk: The timing of assignment differs from the reference, and the full independent verdict is unavailable because of the evaluation timeout; do not promote it to resolved solely by static similarity.
